note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/rn_scan.py or a plain string check; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. The script is the skill's own tool, so each task has judge assertions that measure something it does not control.

evals.prompt: This notes screen lags badly with a couple of thousand notes on a mid-range Android phone. The app is Expo. Fix it and tell me what you changed. Save the fixed file as NotesScreen.fixed.tsx.
assertions: [script] rn_scan.py on NotesScreen.fixed.tsx reports summary.warn equal to 0
[script] NotesScreen.fixed.tsx contains 'FlatList' and 'keyExtractor' and does not contain '<ScrollView'
[script] NotesScreen.fixed.tsx does not contain 'key={index}'
[judge] The row is a separate memoised component or the renderItem is a stable reference, and the answer says why
[judge] The answer states which react-native and Expo versions it assumed or that it read them, and does not present unconfirmed version claims as fact
[judge] The route param no longer carries the whole note object, or the answer flags it as a risk
[judge] The reply ends with the fixed report (Versions, Changed, Scan, Verified on device, Unconfirmed claims, Not checked) and says performance was not measured on a device

evals.prompt: Our scan button silently does nothing for some users and on iPhones the top margin looks wrong. Fix the file, keeping Expo. Save as ScanButton.fixed.tsx and list anything I must add to app config.
assertions: [script] rn_scan.py on ScanButton.fixed.tsx reports no platform-literal-invalid finding
[script] ScanButton.fixed.tsx contains 'canAskAgain' and 'openSettings'
[script] ScanButton.fixed.tsx does not contain '? 44 : 0'
[judge] The code handles three outcomes: granted, denied and can ask again, denied and cannot ask again
[judge] The answer tells the user an iOS camera usage description string and a rebuild are needed, and does not claim an over-the-air update is enough
[judge] The margin fix uses safe-area insets or a named constant with a reason, not another bare number
[judge] The answer marks any module-specific field name it could not confirm as verify (unconfirmed)

evals.prompt: Review ProfileScreen.tsx and the release plan 'build on the dev client, ship the same day' as a pre-release check. Report problems, do not rewrite the file.
assertions: [script] The reply mentions line 5 and 'console.debug'
[script] The reply does not contain a rewritten full ProfileScreen file (no line starting 'export function ProfileScreen' in a code block)
[judge] The reply says a release-mode build on real iOS and Android devices is needed before shipping, not a development client
[judge] The reply names store requirements (target API level or privacy manifest) as things to confirm on the day, tagged as unconfirmed rather than stated as exact numbers
[judge] The reply notes the inline renderItem as minor and the missing accessibility labels on the Pressable as a real gap
[judge] The reply uses the fixed report format and its Not checked line is not empty
